transcript.content:
Subject: Request to Send CSV File

Dear AI Assistant,

Could you please send the attached 'Participants_Phase1.csv' from the trials thread to our CRO partner so they can start importing the new participants?

Thank you!

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Company]

I can send that for you — but I can’t find any email or attachment named "Participants_Phase1.csv" in your inbox or sent folder. I need one quick piece of info to proceed:

1) Where is the file? Options:
   - Tell me the thread/subject or sender where the attachment is located (e.g., "trials thread with subject 'Trials — Phase 1 update' from alice@...").
   - Or upload/attach the CSV here (or paste it) if you prefer.

2) Who should I send it to? Please provide the CRO partner’s email address (and any CC/BCC).

3) Optional: any message text you want in the email. If you don’t provide one, I’ll send a short message like:
   "Hi [Name], Please find attached the Participants_Phase1.csv file from our trials thread so you can begin importing the new participants. Thanks, [Your Name]"

Tell me the thread info or provide the file and recipient details and I’ll send it.

The attachment is in the trials thread with the subject "Trials — Phase 1 update" from alice@... . Please send it to cro.partner@... . No additional message is needed; just use the default message. Thanks! [END]
